verdict.rationale: The SDK documents hooks, which are callback functions that run your code automatically on agent events such as tool calls, session start, or stop. Hooks can block dangerous operations before they execute, and permission rules define what is allowed automatically, so event-triggered rules and actions are clearly first-class. Missing for 10: any evidence of triggers on external events (webhooks, schedules, file or repo changes), a declarative no-code rule format beyond code callbacks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hook behavior.
